access.path: No official API found for adstransparency.google.com. Google community forum threads report a BigQuery public dataset (bigquery-public-data.google_ads_transparency_center, tables creative_stats and removed_creative_stats), but we could not read an official page about it
access.approval: To verify the BigQuery dataset, the account owner must create a Google Cloud project with BigQuery
access.cost: BigQuery public datasets: Google pays for storage and the first 1 TB of queries each month is free (official BigQuery docs)

regions: BigQuery dataset (reported, unverified): advertisers that served ads in the EEA or Turkey
coverage.history: Unverified. The dataset is reported to update periodically, later than the website

dataUse: The project rules exclude scraping adstransparency.google.com, directly or through third-party scraper actors. This is LEGAL_RISK, as for TikTok in ADR-0006.
Political ads have a separate BigQuery dataset (the Political Ads Transparency Report). It is not competitor ad data.
unverified: The Transparency Center pages returned only JavaScript shells to our fetcher. Its FAQ could not be read, and the help article (support.google.com/adspolicy/answer/10284545) returned HTTP 404.
The BigQuery dataset's official page failed to load (header overflow), so its fields, coverage and terms are unverified. One community thread reports 'Access Denied' on the table.

sources.note: Search result title only; political ads

decisionForProductOwner: The website is BLOCKED: there is no API. If EEA and Turkey coverage is enough, create a Google Cloud project so a PoC can verify the BigQuery dataset. Small queries fit in the free 1 TB per month.
